name: Proton 11.0-2e
body:
A small update for Proton 11.0-2:

- Fixed EA App Launcher login window not being focused properly with Gamescope.
- Fixed EA App titles not displaying the correct splash image.

name: Proton 11.0-2
body:
- Now playable:
  - AsteroidsHD
  - Heroes of the Three Kingdoms 7
  - Konkan Coast Pirate Solutions
  - Otherworld Legends 战魂铭人
  - Plain Sight
  - Portal Worlds
  - SMILE GAME BUILDER
  - Tetrageddon Games
  - Warhammer: Dark Omen (Classic)
- Fixed Proton 11 regressions:
  - CEG-using games should no longer take extra time to start.
  - Command & Conquer: Generals, Command & Conquer: Renegade, Command & Conquer Generals Zero Hour, Command & Conquer Red Alert 3, Command & Conquer Red Alert 3, Command & Conquer 3: Kane's Wrath and Command & Conquer 3: Tiberium Wars should detect custom Steam Workshop levels again.
  - Terraria should no longer perform worse than on Proton 10.
  - Arma 3 workshop mods should no longer unnecessarily update on each launch.
  - Source SDK 2007 and Source SDK 2013 Singleplayer should no longer fail to find gameinfo.txt.
  - Natural Selection 2 should be able to connect to servers again.
  - The Talos Principle and The Talos Principle VR should no longer incorrectly show the login window on launch.
  - The King of Fighters XIII Global Match should no longer leak memory.
  - Resident Evil 2 should no longer have issue with using low resolution full screen mode on high resolution screens on certain setups.
  - Homeworld 2 Classic from Homeworld Remastered Collection should now behave correctly on alt+tab.
  - SHOGUN: Total War no longer should end up on a black screen after alt+tab.
  - Need for Speed Hot Pursuit Remastered now has working input when set to fullscreen mode on SteamOS.
  - Addressed performance regression affecting Exanima on certain setups.
  - Improved rendering of the Imperiums: Greek Wars launcher.
  - Crysis 2 Remastered should no longer hang on game load when ray tracing is enabled.
  - Borderlands Game of the Year Enhanced should no longer fail to launch with initialization error.
  - The Coma 3: Bloodlines is playable again.
  - Debug menu in SCP: Secret Laboratory works again.
- Fixed Worms Armageddon ignoring system locale when suggesting language upon team creation.
- Fixed Diablo IV not being playable after a recent game update.
- Fixed Trove Public Test Server failing to launch after a recent game update.
- Fixed Metal Gear Solid V: The Phantom Pain not being playable after a recent game update.
- Fixed Marvel Rivals crashing after a recent game update.
- Fixed Arc Raiders not being playable for some users after a recent game update.
- Fixed Helldivers 2 not launching after a recent game update.
- Fixed Call of Duty (2003) rendering wrong colors in the main menu.
- Fixed Path of Exile crashing caused by specific text in chat.
- Fixed No Limits 2 Roller Coaster Simulation rendering wrong colors with Nvidia GPUs on Wayland.
- Fixed Rocket League incorrectly detecting re-plugged DualShock 4 and DualSense controllers as an additional device.
- Fixed a memory leak in HITMAN World of Assassination.
- Fixed Vagante freezing on character select on setups with using Wayland with Nvidia GPUs.
- Fixed Warhammer: Dark Omen (Classic) displaying low resolution map on certain setups.
- Fixed gamma issues in Exanima showing up on certain setups.
- Fixed Forza Horizon 4, 5 and 6 showing black screen on recent SteamOS versions.
- Fixed Forza Horizon 6 auto-closing after system suspend/resume.
- Fixed Rocket League, Tom Clancy’s The Division 2 and Squad not starting when set to non-English locale.
- Improved reliability of controller hotplug.
- Fixed KeepUp Survival having bad performance and crashing on non-Nvidia GPU.
- Fixed audio distortion in the intro video of Warhammer 40,000: Dakka Squadron - Flyboyz Edition.
- Fixed not being able to interact with the "confirm" button in Lucid Blocks.
- Fixed Mirror's Edge Catalyst freezing on systems without Nvidia GPUs due to nvapi presence.
- Fixed DIRT 5 crashing on CPUs with hybrid cores.
- Fixed sprites not rendering in Zombie Estate 2.
- Fixed Dark and Darker sometimes hanging on start.
- Fixed Escape from Monkey Island crashing on some setups.
- Enabled Xalia for Batman: Arkham City GOTY's settings window.
- Fixed Dungeons & Dragons: Chronicles of Mystara not displaying available resolution correctly on some setups.
- Fixed video playback in Psycho-Sleuth Demo.
- Fixed audio issues in Portal 2 happening on 7.1 setups.
- Fixed sound in Idle Iktah.
- Fixed video playback in STAR WARS Starfighter.
- Fixed saves not working in Hyperdevotion Noire: Goddess Black Heart
- Fixed audio issues in DRAGON QUEST BUILDERS happening after device suspend.
- Fixed RPGMaker Engine games freezing after being minimized inside of gamescope.
- Fixed Moero Chronicle wrongly restarting the intro video every time the game loses focus during playback.
- Fixed intro video playback in Legend of Mana.
- Fixed visual distortions in pre-rendered backgrounds in Resident Evil 0 HD Remaster.
- Fixed War Thunder occasionally crashing when selecting "To Battle!".
- Updated Wine Mono to [11.2.0](https://gitlab.winehq.org/mono/wine-mono/-/releases/wine-mono-11.2.0).
- Updated to [FEX-2607](https://github.com/FEX-Emu/FEX/releases/tag/FEX-2607).
- Updated vkd3d-proton to v3.0a-252-g[212991fc2c26](https://github.com/HansKristian-Work/vkd3d-proton/commit/212991fc2c26) from proton-11 support branch.
- Updated dxvk to v2.7.1-498-g[a6764047e587](https://github.com/doitsujin/dxvk/commit/a6764047e587) from proton-11 support branch.
- Updated vkd3d to [2.0](https://gitlab.winehq.org/wine/vkd3d/-/releases/vkd3d-2.0)
- Updated dxvk-nvapi to [v0.9.2](https://github.com/jp7677/dxvk-nvapi/releases/tag/v0.9.2)

name: Proton 11.0-1
body:
- Now playable (previously worked with Proton Experimental):
  - Universe Generator: The Golden Sword
  - DCS World Steam Edition
  - Resident Evil (1996)
  - Resident Evil 2 (1998)
  - Dino Crisis
  - Dino Crisis 2
  - From Dust
  - Blaite
  - Don't Die Dateless, Dummy!
  - METAL GEAR SURVIVE
  - Warhammer: Vermintide 2
  - Metal Fatigue
  - SHOGUN: Total War
- Newly playable:
  - Unknown Faces
  - Gothic 1 Classic
  - X-Plane 12
  - Breath of Fire IV
  - Deadly Premonition
- Fixed video playback in She Sees Red.
- Fixed rendering of certain symbols with Ukranian language option in Chambers.
- Fixed voice chat in Phasmophobia lobby for desktop players.
- Improved rendering of Rockstar Launcher popups.
- Fixed Sea of Solitude showing black screen on Proton.
- Fixed many EA games being unplayable after a recent EA Desktop update.
- Added support for SteamWorks SDK 1.64.
- Fixed Steam Overlay not working correctly with many EA games.
- Improved emoji support in Idle Trillionaire.
- Fixed intro video playback in Crimson Desert.
- Fixed Rei and the Floating City not being playable with gamescope.
- Fixed mouse movement behavior in Call of Duty 2.
- Fixed rendering issue in launcher of DEATH STRANDING 2: ON THE BEACH.
- Fixed a crash in HELLDIVERS 2 happening in high enemy-count missions.
- Fixed random hangs in Killer Inn.
- Fixed Killer Inn not launching on Steam Decks and other machines with /tmp sizes lower than 10GB.
- Fixed Killer Inn not being able to connect to Square Enix account.
- Fixed graphical gliches in Duck Game that happen with newer Wine Mono versions.
- Fixed REDLauncher (e.g. as seen with Cyberpunk 2077 and The Witcher 3) taking a long time to exit.
- Fixed Hollow Knight wrongly registering Steam Deck's Steam button as a left trigger after a game update.
- Fixed controller hotplug not working for 8BitDo Ultimate 2C and other controllers that expose multiple HID devices.
- Fixed Xalia intermittently failing to start when game is launched.
- Improved timezone detection.
- Fixed video playback in 我打不过漂亮的她们.
- Fixed lag spikes caused by Steam overlay being opened for prolonged time.
- Fixed VR controller tracking in Microsoft Flight Simulator.
- Improved VR support so that No Man's Sky VR mode is playable again.
- Fixed black blocks in dialog windows created by ARC Raiders and The Finals.
- Fixed glitchy video playback in Satisfactory.
- Fixed Rec Room not being playable after a recent game update.
- Fixed THE KING OF FIGHTERS XIII GLOBAL MATCH freezing when playing videos from the gallery.
- Fixed intro video not looping in Blazblue Centralfiction.
- Made more games using MonoGame playable.
- Improved support for Kodi media player.
- Added System Voice support for multiple languages in Phasmophobia.
- Fixed KDE window maximization support.
- Fixed Brighter Shores window resizing support.
- Improved Space Engineers dual monitor support
- Fixed scaling issue with Arma Reforger when changing window modes.
- Fixed Dungeon Siege tools showing up at character's feet.
- Improved focus loss behavior with RoBoRumble.
- Fixed rendering issue in Hellsinker. launcher.
- Fixed stutter from keyboard input in Titanfall 2.
- Fixed audio playback when playing intro videos in BIRDCAGE.
- Fixed hang after METAL GEAR SOLID 2: Sons of Liberty - Master Collection Version end credits.
- Fixed Disintegration getting stuck on the first loading screen.
- Fixed CHRONO TRIGGER flickering in windowed mode with certain resolutions when using Gamescope.
- RAGE no longer has focus issues when Alt-Tabbing on KDE Wayland.
- The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Game of the Year Edition (2009) no longer has problems minimizing after Alt-Tabbing.
- Resident Evil 2 should no longer have issues when changing resolutions on GNOME.
- Call of Duty: WWII should no longer fail to render properly in fullscreen native resolution on setups with dual monitors.
- Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition no longer has issues with keyboard registration after refocusing the game.
- Fixed Far Cry 4 randomly hanging during launch.
- Updated Xalia to [0.4.9](https://github.com/madewokherd/xalia/releases/tag/xalia-0.4.9):
    - Fixed lockups happening when interacting with the EA App.
    - Added controller support for the MC Visual C++ 2010 redistributable installer.
    - Improved gamepad binding support for Graze Counter.
    - Added controller support for launchers of the following games: Red Faction®: Armageddon™, Final Fantasy X/X-2 HD Remaster, Sonic the Hedgehog 4 Episode II, Hellsinker., Disney Bolt, STAR WARS™ Starfighter™, Rocket Knight, Puddle, Zero Escape: The Nonary Games, Metal Slug XX, Mortal Kombat Komplete Edition, Disney Epic Mickey 2: The Power of Two, Batman: Arkham Asylum GOTY, LocoCycle, Ys SEVEN, Resident Evil (1996), Resident Evil 2 (1998), Resident Evil 3 Nemesis (1999), Dino Crisis, Dino Crisis 2.
    - Fixed Xalia wrongly selecting option from unfocused tabs in Rayman: Raving Rabbids.
    - Added controller support for DirectX Runtime Components installer when launching BioShock for the first time.
- Rebased on top of [Wine 11.0](https://gitlab.winehq.org/wine/wine/-/releases/wine-11.0).
- Added [FEX-2605](https://github.com/FEX-Emu/FEX/releases/tag/FEX-2605) for ARM64EC builds.
- Updated vkd3d to [vkd3d-1.19](https://gitlab.winehq.org/wine/vkd3d/-/releases/vkd3d-1.19)-139-g[30b93dcea8b0](https://gitlab.winehq.org/wine/vkd3d/-/commit/30b93dcea8b0).
- Updated dxvk to v2.7.1-467-g[83e503b4ae6d](https://github.com/doitsujin/dxvk/commit/83e503b4ae6d) from [Proton 11 support branch](https://github.com/doitsujin/dxvk/tree/proton-11).
- Updated dxvk-nvapi to [v0.9.1](https://github.com/jp7677/dxvk-nvapi/releases/tag/v0.9.1).
- Updated Wine Mono to [11.0.0](https://gitlab.winehq.org/mono/wine-mono/-/releases/wine-mono-11.0.0).
- Updated vkd3d-proton to [proton-20260410](https://github.com/HansKristian-Work/vkd3d-proton/tree/proton-20260410)
